raw_response: {"diagnosis": "In silver_transactions, txn_date is derived from CAST(ingest_ts AS DATE), the batch load date, which is always the day after txn_ts (02:00 load). The mismatch count of 4600 equals the POSTED row count, so every POSTED row fails the DATE_CONSISTENCY check. Deriving txn_date from txn_ts restores the invariant, and the gold tables rebuild from silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
